# What the server does with no scheduler flag. Do not edit by hand: regenerate on
# purpose (see tests/server/gpu_path_pin.rs) and justify each changed line.

== flags ==
--agent-hello-burst default=60 required=false
--agent-hello-interval default=1s required=false
--agent-pool-config default=none required=false
--agent-token-file default=none required=false
--boot default=none required=true values=initialise|resume
--default-ttl default=600s required=false
--drain-timeout default=10s required=false
--handshake-timeout default=10s required=false
--header-timeout default=10s required=false
--listen default=127.0.0.1:7300 required=false
--max-connections default=256 required=false
--max-requests default=100 required=false
--max-ttl default=3600s required=false
--pool-config default=none required=false
--read-timeout default=30s required=false
--state-file default=none required=true
--tick default=5s required=false
--tls-cert default=none required=false
--tls-key default=none required=false
--token-file default=none required=true
--write-timeout default=10s required=false

== state-files ==
without agent flags
  before start: (empty)
  after start: leases.toml leases.toml.lock
  after acquire: leases.toml leases.toml.lock
  after shutdown: leases.toml leases.toml.lock
with agent flags
  before start: (empty)
  after start: leases.toml leases.toml.lock
  after acquire: leases.toml leases.toml.lock
  after an agent joins: leases.toml leases.toml.agents leases.toml.lock
  after shutdown: leases.toml leases.toml.agents leases.toml.lock

after start
version = 1
term = 1
next_sequence = 1
lease_count = 0
lease = []

next_sequence = 2
lease_count = 1
